title: Consent for a child's sedation for CT
stem: Paediatric area. Tsz-yan, 4 (16 kg), fell 1.5 m from a climbing frame. GCS 14, two vomits, a boggy swelling over the right temple. She needs a CT head but is too distressed to lie still. Explain to her father why she needs the scan and sedation, and obtain his consent.
notes:
Checked against NICE NG232 (Head injury, 2023), the PECARN rule, the Hong Kong Hospital Authority paediatric sedation guideline, and AAP/AAPD 2019 sedation guidance.

CT head within 1 hour for a child with GCS under 15 at 2 hours, suspected skull fracture or tense fontanelle, signs of basal skull fracture, focal deficit, seizure; or, with two or more of: loss of consciousness over 5 minutes, abnormal drowsiness, three or more vomits, dangerous mechanism (NICE NG232 lowered some thresholds). A boggy temporal haematoma in a young child is a high-risk sign (PECARN).

Sedation: consider non-drug measures first (parent present, distraction, swaddling). HA guideline options for non-painful imaging: IV midazolam 0.05–0.1 mg/kg titrated (children 3 years and over), intranasal dexmedetomidine 2–3 microgram/kg, or chloral hydrate under 3 years. Risks: respiratory depression, airway obstruction, desaturation, hypotension, paradoxical agitation, vomiting. Monitoring: pulse oximetry, ECG, BP, capnography; a dedicated person watching the child; resuscitation equipment and reversal (flumazenil 0.01 mg/kg). Fasting is not required when the procedure is urgent. Recovery until back to baseline.

Your notes match the HA guideline closely. The concern with sedation in head injury: a falling GCS may be masked, so the team watches closely and the CT is done promptly.

steps.label: Check before sedation
steps.hint: Weight, allergies, medical problems, snoring/airway, last meal, previous sedation.

Safety.t: Allergies? Medical problems? Heart or lung disease?
Safety.tz: 佢有冇藥物敏感？有咩病？心臟或者肺有冇問題？

Safety.t: Does she snore or have breathing problems at night?
Safety.tz: 佢夜晚有冇扯鼻鼾，或者呼吸問題？

Safety.t: When did she last eat and drink?
Safety.tz: 佢最後幾時食嘢同飲嘢？
Safety.rz: 十二點食晏，兩點飲過嘢。而家四點。
Safety.r: Lunch at 12, a drink at 2. It's 4 now.

Safety.t: Has she had sedation or an anaesthetic before?
Safety.tz: 佢以前有冇用過鎮靜劑或者全身麻醉？

steps.label: Talk to Mr Tsui
steps.hint: Why the CT, why sedation, how, risks, monitoring, alternatives, consent.

turns.line: Why does she need a scan? Isn't that a lot of radiation?
turns.lz: 點解佢要照掃描？輻射會唔會好多？

opts.t: I understand your worry. She's more drowsy than we'd expect, has vomited twice and has swelling over the temple, which can go with a skull fracture or bleeding. The scan uses a small radiation dose, and missing a bleed would be far more serious.
opts.tz: 我明白你擔心。佢比我哋預期中眼瞓，嘔咗兩次，太陽穴仲腫咗，呢啲可能代表頭骨裂或者腦出血。掃描嘅輻射劑量好細，但係漏咗腦出血就嚴重得多。
opts.rz: 好……但係佢一定唔肯瞓定定。
opts.r: OK… but she won't lie still.
opts.mark: Explains the indication for CT and weighs radiation risk

opts.tz: 個個都照㗎，例行公事啫。
opts.r: Then why does she need it?

turns.line: OK… but she won't lie still.
turns.lz: 好……但係佢一定唔肯瞓定定。

opts.t: We'll try with you holding her hand first. If that doesn't work, a small dose of a sedative (midazolam) through the drip will make her sleepy for the scan.
opts.tz: 我哋會先試吓俾你拖住佢隻手。如果唔得，就經吊針俾少少鎮靜劑（midazolam），令佢眼瞓，方便照掃描。
opts.rz: 咁對個細路女嚟講安唔安全？
opts.r: Is that safe for a little girl?
opts.mark: Offers non-drug measures and explains the sedation

turns.line: Is that safe for a little girl?
turns.lz: 咁對個細路女嚟講安唔安全？

opts.t: It's generally very safe. The main risk is that it can slow her breathing, which we watch for all the time with monitors and a nurse by her side; we have medicines to reverse it. She might be grumpy or vomit afterwards. Do you have any questions? Are you happy for us to go ahead?
opts.tz: 一般嚟講好安全。主要風險係可能令佢呼吸慢咗，所以我哋會一直用儀器監察，仲有護士喺佢身邊；我哋亦都有藥可以解。之後佢可能會扭計或者嘔。你有冇問題想問？你同唔同意我哋進行？
opts.rz: 同意。我可唔可以陪住佢？
opts.r: Yes. Can I stay with her?
opts.mark: Explains risks, monitoring and reversal; obtains consent

opts.t: Yes, until she's asleep, and straight after. She'll stay with us until she's fully awake.
opts.tz: 可以，陪到佢瞓着為止，完咗之後即刻可以陪返佢。佢會留喺我哋度，直至完全醒返。
opts.mark: Involves the parent and explains recovery

qs.q: IV midazolam dose for procedural sedation in a 4-year-old?
wrong: 0.5 mg/kg as a single bolus over 1 min
5 mg fixed dose for any child

qs.q: Why is sedation a concern in head injury?
qs.a: It can mask a falling conscious level
wrong: It raises intracranial pressure directly in all children
It stops the CT being done

qs.a: SpO2, ECG, BP, capnography, dedicated observer
wrong: None if a parent is present

badge.name: Sweet Dreams
badge.flavor: Why the scan, why the sedative, what can happen, who's watching.

cards.q: PECARN high-risk feature in a child under 2?
options: A fall from a sitting position
cards.why: Also altered mental status and palpable skull fracture.

options: A rising core temperature in infants

cards.q: Fasting before urgent ED sedation is…
options: Not mandatory; weigh urgency against risk

cards.q: NICE CT within 1 hour in a child: which sign?
options: A single vomit after the fall at home
Crying and distress at the scene
cards.why: Also GCS <15 at 2 h, basal skull signs, seizure, focal deficit.
